reason: A statement in a living document is false as of 6 Nov 2026: it says the release gate has never run in GitHub Actions, and its logs show it has. A reader of §7 would underestimate what has been exercised and misplace what has not (C5, C7).

proposed_change.summary: Replace the third bullet of docs/DEPLOYMENT.md §7 so it states what the logs of pages.yml runs 86 and 87 show, and what they leave unmeasured.

operations.current:
- That the release gate (§2a) has ever run in GitHub Actions. It is implemented and tested locally; the first push to `main`
  after it is merged is its first run, and a failure there is a finding about the gate, not about the site.
operations.proposed:
- That the release gate (§2a) has exercised every condition. It has run in GitHub Actions: the logs of `pages.yml` runs 86 (`6bfe537`)
  and 87 (`149e9b7`), read on 6 Nov 2026, show C1, C2, C3, C4, C6, C9 and C10 satisfied, C5 and C7 not measured (no decision ledger
  and no commit declaring a Proposal) and C8 reported (five agent-marked commits, not blocking). An earlier pair of runs, 76 and 77,
  is recorded in `docs/ROADMAP-v2.md` §8 (5 Nov 2026). A pass with C5 and C7 unmeasured says nothing about whether an approval is
  authentic or whether an agent change was decided before it was made.
operations.rationale: The only statement under docs/ in a living document that is false against the gate logs; the sentence is replaced by what was read in them, with C5, C7 and C8 named as they printed.

proposed_change.scope_note: One file, one bullet. Does not touch AGENTS.md or agent/implement/decisions/README.md (outside docs/), does not rewrite docs/AUDIT-2026-11-04.md or any dated report, and does not change the other bullets of §7, the settings of §3a, the grant, a gate condition or the production dispatcher.
